race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
race.verdict: KEATS HOUSE has responded well to the blinkers and is taken to resume winning ways with Rhys Elliott taking a handy 5 lb off. Titainium will be a threat if able to build on his latest back-to-form fourth at Newcastle. Billy Loughnane's mount Burford Beauty is next on the list ahead of Good Karma , who can play a part if his stamina holds back up at a 1m. KEATS HOUSE (IRE) TITAINIUM BURFORD BEAUTY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Keats House (4/1), Burford Beauty (5/1), Titainium (6/1), Good Karma (7/1), Asian Journey (7/1), San Juanito (10/1), Soames Forsyte (10/1), Aneirin's Sword (10/1), Ceinture D'orion (12/1), Union Island (20/1), Upepo (20/1), King Of Charm (25/1), Sunshine And Roses (25/1)
